menu_berserker_desc:
BASIC: ##$basic##
Every hit that you receive grants you a ##$multibasic## damage increase with melee weapons.

Stacks up to ##$multibasic2## times. Receiving health hits grants ##double## the stacks. The stacks decay at the rate of ##$multibasic3## stack per second.

ACE: ##$pro##
Every hit that you receive grants you a ##$multipro## damage increase with ranged weapons.

Stacks up to ##$multipro2## times. Receiving health hits grants ##double## the stacks. The stacks decay at the rate of ##$multipro3## stack per second.
menu_frenzy_desc:
BASIC: ##$basic##
Killing an enemy with a melee attack grants you a ##$multibasic## damage reduction and armor suppression immunity for ##$multibasic2## seconds.

This cannot occur more than once every ##$multibasic3## seconds.

ACE: ##$pro##
Killing an enemy with a melee attack also resets all currently running ability cooldowns.

This cannot occur more than once every ##$multibasic3## seconds.

Note: Does not reset Perk Deck throwable and Basic ##"Frenzy"## cooldowns.
